:::{#def-sample-space}
#### Sample space

The **sample space** of a [random experiment](#def-random-experiment), denoted $\samplespace$,
is the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/sets.html#def-set) of all of its possible outcomes
[@wikipedia_sample_space].

:::
